title: Keep Runtime QA Blind to the Implementation
summary: Henry Nguyen separates an implementation-aware orchestrator from fresh testers that receive only a bounded user mission and simulator controls. The skill defines contamination rules, structured symptom reports, neutral regression missions, and honest limits for device-only behavior. A team can trial the boundary on one fixed defect and compare the blind report with its existing regression evidence.
takeaway: After an agent fixes one user-facing defect, give a fresh tester only the staged app, Simulator identifier, and a neutral mission; discard any report that reveals source or prior-finding knowledge.
